overview_description.description: Mederva Health is a provider of a medical consultation platform for doctors and patients. They intended to help physicians improve skills and increase knowledge to help their patients and their practice. They provide a platform for continuing education to help improve their skills in their area of expertise.

product.name: Remote Care
product.description: A telehealth service enabling virtual consultations between patients and licensed healthcare professionals via chat or video.

product.name: Wellness Services
product.description: Non-clinical health coaching and lifestyle support services aimed at improving patient well-being through behavior change.

product.name: Personalized Health Plans
product.description: Customized care plans tailored to individual patient health needs to manage chronic conditions and improve well-being.

product.name: Mobile Health Application
product.description: An AI-powered mobile app providing patients with access to personalized health programs, care teams, and guidance.
